fields.label: Department
fields.note: The 12 department cards in section#openings; each is a /<slug>/ taxonomy page listing that department's postings.

fields.label: Location
fields.note: Not a portal control: postings state the city in the title ('(Chicago based)'); values come from the collected rows.

notes: careers.media.net is a WordPress careers site. The home page publishes 12 department cards (section#openings, 'Open Positions') and each department page lists its postings; there is no search box, no form, no select and no pagination anywhere on the site, and details are server-rendered. Every keyword/filter therefore has to be applied locally over the collected set.
evidence: https://careers.media.net/ -> 200, 12 department cards (Data Science & Analytics, Engineering, ..., Information Technology), no form/input/select
